explanation.headline: FDA's records show zolpidem tartrate is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include zolpidem tartrate as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale Lakeside holds 12 tablets with 5.4 days of supply at 2.2 tablets per day.
Corvale East holds 216 tablets with 34.8 days of supply at 6.2 tablets per day and can spare 19 tablets while retaining 32 days on hand.
The top-ranked option is to transfer 19 tablets of 12.5 mg from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside, which would raise Lakeside to 14 days on hand.
This transfer requires pharmacy director approval and a controlled-substance transfer record for Schedule III-V.

rejected.text: All three Corvale sites receive the same product labeled by Sandoz Inc (NDC 00781531631) manufactured at the SANDOZ plant.
rejected.reason: "three" is a number in words; numbers must be digits from the evidence

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
